description.en: The scope of the instance types to query. Default value: `Public`.

description.zh: 变配时传入需要变配的共享型云电脑ID，返回值会增加规格与共享型云电脑之间是否兼容的信息。
description.en: The ID of the desktop group to reconfigure. If you specify this parameter, the response returns only the instance types that are compatible with the specified group.

description.zh: 变配时传入需要变配的云电脑ID，返回值会增加规格与云电脑之间是否兼容的信息。
description.en: The ID of the WUYING Workspace to reconfigure. If you specify this parameter, the response returns only the instance types that are compatible with the specified workspace.

description.zh:
规格ID。

> 当`InstanceTypeFamily`和`DesktopTypeId`参数的取值均为空时，将查询云电脑所有规格的信息。
description.en:
The ID of the instance type.

> If you omit both the `InstanceTypeFamily` and `DesktopTypeId` parameters, the operation returns all available WUYING Workspace instance types.
An array of instance type IDs.

description.zh:
规格族名称。

> 当`InstanceTypeFamily`和`DesktopTypeId`参数的取值均为空时，将查询云电脑所有规格的信息。
description.en:
The instance type family.

> If you omit both the `InstanceTypeFamily` and `DesktopTypeId` parameters, the operation returns all available WUYING Workspace instance types.

description.zh: 排序字段，若不指定则按照创建时间倒序排列。
description.en: The property by which to sort the results. If you omit this parameter, the results are sorted by creation time in descending order.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to query the regions that Elastic Desktop Service supports.
The billing method of the instance types.

description.zh: 查询规则支持的多会话数量。
description.en: Filters for instance types that support at least the specified number of concurrent sessions. This parameter applies only to multi-session instance types.

description.zh: > 该参数未对外开放使用。
